Reference / crypto/ed25519

crypto/ed25519#

Ed25519 signatures (RFC 8032, pure, deterministic).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let key = Ed25519PrivateKey(entropy: SystemEntropy());
key.public_key().verified(message, key.signature(message)); // true

Description#

Ed25519 signatures (RFC 8032, pure, deterministic). A private key is its 32-byte seed held as SecretBytes (Ed25519PrivateKey(seed: ...)); Ed25519PrivateKey(entropy: ...) draws a fresh seed. The two constructors have one parameter each, so they are selected by argument name. Signing needs no randomness. Verification is strict (canonical S, no small-order public keys) and answers false for invalid signatures. Ed25519PublicKey holds the raw 32-byte key; bytes() is its SPKI DER.
